votes.motion: Recommend appointment of Genevier Nass as Beach Coordinator and Cheryl Shaw, Catherine Keefer, Elizabeth Simeone, Lynn Major and Ethan Gengler as Lifeguards
votes.quote: motioned to recommend appointment of genevier nass as beach coordinator and cheryl shaw, catherine keefer, elizabeth simeone, lynn major and ethan gengler as lifeguards. pete seconded. passed 3-0

votes.motion: Keep swim lesson fees at $20 per child / $60 max per family per session for the 2018 season
votes.quote: karin motioned for swim lesson fees to remain at $20 per child / $60 max per family per session for the 2018 season. dennis seconded. approved 3-0.

votes.motion: Keep the 2018 beach fees the same as last season (Resident Family $50, Resident Individual $35, Resident Senior $20, Non Resident Family $75, Non Resident Individual $50, Daily Rate $5 adult, $3 student)
votes.quote: daily rate - $5adult, $3 student karin seconded. approved 3-0.

votes.motion: Open the town beach to the public from June 23rd to August 26th
votes.quote: dennis motioned to open the town beach to the public from june 23rd to august 26th. pete seconded. approved 3-0.

votes.motion: Research the cost and find a funding mechanism for an AED device for Town Beach for the start of the 2018 season
votes.quote: for the start of the 2018 season. karin seconded. approved 3-0.

votes.motion: Allow the Beach Coordinator to organize and run the Great Cardboard Boat Race on August 4th with a rain date of August 11th
votes.quote: karin motioned to allow the beach coordinator to organize and run the great cardboard boat race on august 4th with a rain date of august 11th. pete seconded. approved 3-0.

votes.motion: Approve Central MA Baseball use of the 90' diamond at Marshall Park for 6 weeks starting mid June at $10 per player per season, conditional on Certificate of Insurance and confirmation of final dates
votes.quote: to use the 90' diamond at marshall park for 6 weeks starting in mid june at cost of $10 per player per season
